I own a 98 Malibu that I bought at an auction. It runs and its paid for so I'm happy. However, I noticed that it is starting to get a nice ring of rust around the fuel door. Virtually every Malibu/classic from that set of years has the same thing. Why is that? What can I do for it?

Answer from the Malibu forums, all credit to "The bored Kiel"

"The reason this happens is there is a piece of foam directly below the gas cap housing and there is a small gap perfect for collecting salt/sand and never being flushed out because it's somewhat hidden"

To fix this would involve sanding it and using body filler or "bondo" If you want to prevent additional damage, Sand the rust (along with your clear coat) in the area re-paint (with clear-coat) and wash often with fresh water

It will look like crap but at least it wont rust anymore LOL
